description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirement Both Rites are 1 action and target only you.

Cast two Rites for the Zeal cost of one.

Cast two Rites you know, paying the Zeal cost of the more expensive one only. Both resolve on you before you take any other action. If either Rite would be Zealotry, you cannot use this feat.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Cast two known Rites paying only the costlier's Zeal, both resolving before any other action" -- no confirmed precedent found either way for casting two spells simultaneously as a single action within this pass's research budget. Also separately gated by Zeal accounting (P-ZEAL doesn't apply to the cost-waiver mechanism itself, but the underlying Zeal pool it references still doesn't exist as a rule element).
